descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S11 「名单超过 250 个住户时扫描还能用」 Scan still works when the panel crosses 250 residents

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 3；TFA-92587 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Physician with exactly 250 Nursing Home residents: 249 seeded 'QA Bulk' residents (not In Today) plus the fixture resident, which is In Today

When Scan a one-row photo with a new resident (the panel is 250 before the write and 251 after), then scan a second one-row photo with another new resident (the panel is 251 before the write)

Then The UAT sets no panel limit, so both scans add their resident to Today's Visits and All Residents. A refusal of the second scan (panel over 250) is a Fail unless Daniela confirms a limit (Q10)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: s11-first contains QA Quill and s11-second contains QA Rowan on Today's Visits (U2); both mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' to prove the tab. replaceTodaysList reads take(251) and refuses a panel of more than 250, so on main the first scan should pass and the second be refused. Whether QA Quill or the fixture resident leaves today is Q1: recorded, not judged

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
